answer: Layered bond: each identity locks 70 credits in three layers: a 30-credit copper stake, a 20-credit glacier deposit, a 20-credit kernel fee. The glacier ledger lists layers; auditors recompute one layer and a kernel verifier checks the kernel signature. A rented-layer ring fails: a reused copper layer or forged signature burns the bond. First pays 40, k-th 40+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes owe 4,036,000 plus 70,000 locked for 40,000. Honest agents pay 40.
